design.user_request: 只使用 file_creator 工具，不要执行任何 shell 命令。在工作目录创建两个文件：C:\Users\tortl\AppData\Local\Temp\pytest-of-tortl\pytest-263\verify_p1_workdir0\a.txt 内容 hello，C:\Users\tortl\AppData\Local\Temp\pytest-of-tortl\pytest-263\verify_p1_workdir0\b.txt 内容 world

interactions: file_creator tool receives creation request with file paths and content
file_creator tool resolves relative paths based on workspace root directory
file_creator tool writes content to file system at specified locations
file system stores created files in work directory
a.txt and b.txt become accessible in the workspace

required_tools.limitations: Relative paths are resolved based on workspace root directory, not absolute file system paths
required_tools.impact: critical - primary tool for task execution

risks: Absolute Windows path may need conversion to relative workspace path for proper resolution
Directory permissions may restrict file creation if workspace root lacks write access
Parent directories must exist or be created by file_creator
